_hinweis: Oeffentlich auf /changelog (Jan, 29.10.2026). NUR was geaendert wurde — nichts Offenes, nichts bewusst Belassenes, keine Gesamtzahl der Befunde, keine Angriffsdetails. Englisch, ein Satz je Zeile. Neuester Review zuerst.

reviews.text: We went through the server, the website and the app interfaces looking for weaknesses. This is what we changed.

punkte.text: "Hide location" now holds everywhere: records, photos, spot comparison, share images, run details and what friends see while you ride.
Changing or resetting your password signs you out on all other devices.
Better protection against password guessing, and passwords are stored with stronger hashing, upgraded automatically at your next login.

punkte.bereich: Sign in with Google, Apple, Facebook
punkte.text: An existing account is only joined by e-mail address when the provider has confirmed that address.
Connecting Polar, Suunto or COROS only completes for the account that started it, and their access keys are stored encrypted.
Pairing codes can no longer be tried out in bulk, and watch keys are stored only in a form that cannot be used if it ever leaked.
Oversized or malformed files (archives, images, workout files, recordings) are rejected before they can strain the server.
Share links switch themselves off after four weeks.
A blocked photo can no longer be opened through its direct link.
The consent page shows in large letters which service your recordings go to, and warns if it is not a known AI provider.
Server and website libraries were updated and are checked automatically every week for known vulnerabilities.
An automatic check stops data files and secrets from being published to our public code repository.
The server runs in a locked-down environment and can only write where it has to.
Notification and admin functions were tightened and several checks were made stricter.
